inference.confidence_interval: paired per-user normal approximation: mean +/- 1.96 * sample SE
inference.relative_delta: mean_delta / reference_mean; null when the reference mean is zero

limitations: Single training seed; paired user intervals do not measure training-seed variance.
Protocol effects reuse the same checkpoint; they measure evaluation and post-processing changes.
Intervals are unadjusted for multiple comparisons; they are null for fewer than two users.
